newsitem.title: USA: Dec cash flow to U.S. stock funds $13.5 bln--ICI.
newsitem.headline: Dec cash flow to U.S. stock funds $13.5 bln--ICI.

text.p: Net new cash flows to U.S. stock mutual funds was estimated at $13.5 billion in December, down from actual inflows of $17.1 billion in November, an industry group said Monday.

The slowing likely reflects the volatility of the stock market in early December and the tendency to defer purchases until the funds completed their year-end dividend and capital gains distributions, the Investment Company Institute said.
Bond and income funds had an estimated inflow of $3.5 billion in December, compared with an inflow of $1.34 billion in November, ICI said.
The December estimate includes sizable conversions of bank trust assets to mutual funds. Excluding the conversions, the estimated flow in December was roughly in line with November, the group said.
The monthly estimates are derived from unpublished weekly estimates based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets.

The December estimates are particularly susceptible to the seasonal effects of year-end capital gains distributions that may result in larger-than-normal estimation errors, and should be treated with caution, ICI said.
ICI said it will release actual figures for December in approximately three weeks time.
